title: NCAA: Perpetual snaps losing streak at Arellano's expense
summary: Perpetual Help finally broke free of its slump in the NCAA Season 102 men's basketball tournament, taking a 65-58 win over Arellano University on Monday at the FilOil EcoOil Centre in San Juan.
